t: Poor Companions worried the rich would outpace them
a: تَقُولُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، حَتَّى يَكُونَ مِنْهُنَّ كُلِّهِنَّ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ
m: Shall I not teach you something by which you will catch up with those ahead of you? Glorify Allah, praise Him and magnify Him thirty-three times after every prayer.
